freeze.amendment_policy: Freeze the unresolved physical model in a new higher-revision manifest before assigning or accessing a future holdout; retain this manifest and explain every delta.

scope.claim_target: Branch-A independent-scalar coupling to finite-dimensional quantum dynamics and a held-out hardware outcome
excluded_claims: Identification of the independent scalar phi with the Ricci scalar R
A prediction of a 29.64757 MeV particle
Reproduction of the historical ARC 94.6 percent record
scope.interpretation: A rejection kills only the tested action, coupling, measurement, or ARC bridge; standard QM reference utilities and the CE core are separate targets.

input_artifacts.role: standard-QM references, branch-A scalar scaffolding, and explicit spectrum/KMS/Kossakowski gates
input_artifacts.provenance: Repository-local code snapshot frozen before physical model completion and future-holdout assignment.

frozen_inputs.name: scalar_branch
frozen_inputs.source: Audit-selected type-safe branch; phi is not R

allowed_preassignment_conventions: Reduced generator convention H_int/hbar with g squared times J in inverse seconds.
SI energy-coupling convention with gamma=(g_J/hbar)^2 times an unsymmetrized correlation spectrum in seconds.

required_before_assignment: Freeze a dimensional scalar action and all unit conventions.
Freeze g, A, O_phi, bath state, and J(omega) from non-holdout information.
Freeze the device-level candidate likelihood and standard-QM baseline likelihood.
Freeze the measurement instrument, decoder or ARC map, and every nuisance treatment.
Change evaluation_readiness to ready only in a higher-revision manifest created before holdout access.

exploratory_or_calibration.provenance: Repository documentation records a 94.6 percent ARC simulation result, but the current checkout has no raw artifact, seed, executable benchmark, device data, or decoder configuration that reproduces it.
exploratory_or_calibration.why_not_holdout: The value was known before this freeze and lacks a reproducible raw artifact, so it is neither untouched nor evaluation-ready.

qualification_criteria: A public, versioned raw or shot-level quantum-hardware dataset is released after 2026-08-02.
The release contains device and calibration metadata, timestamps or sequence order, circuit or control definitions, and outcome records sufficient for both frozen likelihoods.
At least two devices or independently isolated device epochs are available for cluster-level uncertainty estimation.
No candidate-model developer has inspected the numerical holdout outcomes before assignment.
Training and non-holdout calibration records are disjoint from the assigned evaluation records.
selection_policy.disqualification_rule: If the first release fails any criterion, record the reason without inspecting outcome-dependent candidate performance and consider the next chronological release.

fit_policy.nuisance_parameter_policy: All device, drift, SPAM, decoder, and noise nuisance treatment must be frozen from disjoint training or calibration data in the higher-revision assignment manifest; none may be estimated from holdout outcomes.

numeric_tolerances.name: density_trace_absolute_error
numeric_tolerances.scope: Absolute error of Tr(rho)-1 for every evaluated state or channel output

numeric_tolerances.name: minimum_choi_eigenvalue
numeric_tolerances.scope: Minimum Choi eigenvalue for each registered quantum channel

numeric_tolerances.name: born_probability_sum_absolute_error
numeric_tolerances.scope: Absolute error of the complete Born-probability sum from one

numeric_tolerances.name: minimum_born_probability
numeric_tolerances.scope: Minimum registered Born or instrument outcome probability

numeric_tolerances.name: no_signalling_max_probability_variation
numeric_tolerances.scope: Maximum remote-marginal variation under local setting changes

numeric_tolerances.name: minimum_spectral_density
numeric_tolerances.scope: Minimum evaluated J(omega) before multiplying by g squared

numeric_tolerances.name: minimum_kossakowski_eigenvalue
numeric_tolerances.scope: Minimum eigenvalue of every registered Kossakowski matrix

numeric_tolerances.name: kms_log_detailed_balance_absolute_error
numeric_tolerances.scope: For a registered thermal bath, absolute error of log(gamma_up/gamma_down)+beta*DeltaE

acceptance_criteria.comparison: CE branch-A candidate minus standard-QM device baseline on identical held-out records

verdict_bands.PASS: All physicality gates pass and the lower 95 percent confidence bound of paired delta log predictive density is greater than zero.
verdict_bands.OPEN: All physicality gates pass and the confidence interval includes zero.
verdict_bands.REJECT: A physicality hard kill fires or the upper 95 percent confidence bound is less than or equal to zero.

acceptance_criteria.interpretation: PASS promotes only the frozen branch-A experimental bridge. It is not a posterior probability that CE or a 29.64757 MeV particle is true.

hard_kill_rules.condition: The candidate identifies phi with R, or changes from branch A after holdout access.
A registered channel violates trace preservation, Hermiticity, positivity, complete positivity, or the frozen Choi-eigenvalue tolerance.
hard_kill_rules.action: Reject the tested open-system dynamics bridge regardless of predictive score.

hard_kill_rules.condition: Born nonnegativity, Born normalization, or the frozen no-signalling tolerance fails.
hard_kill_rules.action: Reject the tested measurement or instrument bridge regardless of predictive score.

hard_kill_rules.condition: J(omega) is below the frozen tolerance, a GKSL rate is negative, the Kossakowski representation is not positive semidefinite within tolerance, or a bath registered as thermal violates the frozen KMS detailed-balance tolerance.
hard_kill_rules.action: Reject the tested spectral-density and dissipative-rate bridge.

hard_kill_rules.condition: All physicality gates pass but the upper 95 percent paired confidence bound of candidate-minus-baseline log predictive density is less than or equal to zero.
hard_kill_rules.action: Reject the frozen empirical candidate at the registered data sensitivity.

hard_kill_rules.condition: The manifest digest, input artifact digest, or assigned holdout digest does not match.
hard_kill_rules.action: Invalidate the evaluation and require a documented higher-revision manifest before any rerun.

hard_kill_rules.condition: Any forbidden physics, device, decoder, threshold, baseline, or nuisance value is fit or selected after holdout access.
hard_kill_rules.action: Invalidate confirmatory status; report the result only as exploratory.

hard_kill_rules.condition: The same records are used for calibration or training and holdout scoring.
hard_kill_rules.action: Invalidate the split and allocate a new future holdout.

hard_kill_rules.condition: The future dataset is accessed before model completion and assignment are frozen in a higher-revision manifest.
hard_kill_rules.action: Classify the accessed dataset as exploratory forever and allocate a new future holdout.

hard_kill_rules.condition: The action, correlator, spectral-density provenance, measurement instrument, or rate units remain unspecified at evaluation time.
hard_kill_rules.action: Do not run or score the confirmatory evaluation.
